question.title: Ranking Products by Sales
question.desc: Rank products by their total sales across different regions, considering only products with sales in more than one region.
question.solution:
WITH ranked_products AS (
         SELECT 
            p.product_name,
            SUM(s.sales_amount) AS total_sales,
            COUNT(DISTINCT s.region) AS num_regions
         FROM 
            sales s
         JOIN 
            products p ON s.product_id = p.product_id
         GROUP BY 
            p.product_name
         HAVING 
            COUNT(DISTINCT s.region) > 1
      )
      SELECT 
         product_name,
         total_sales,
         DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS rank
      FROM 
         ranked_products;
question.tips: Consider using window functions for ranking and CTEs for intermediate calculations.
